commands.name: osm-load
commands.help: load an OpenStreetMap extract downloaded by hand (--inbox, or --file PATH)

commands.name: segment-match
commands.help: rematch the lane sources and OpenStreetMap to ACHD's segments by hand [names...]

storage: Small: reference layers re-read weekly or monthly; raw.record grows only by changed versions. The last two OpenStreetMap extracts are kept in $TVT_ARCHIVE/osm/.
ethics: OpenStreetMap is ODbL: credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors", and anything published from it stays ODbL. Geofabrik's robots.txt disallows scripted downloads, so extracts are downloaded by hand and there is no download code. ACHD's and ITD's layers state no license: used internally, credited.
